title: Review of Fines for Illegal Deployment of Foreign Domestic Workers
what_it_is: Review of Fines for Illegal Deployment of Foreign Domestic Workers

sections.label: Fines for illegal deployment
sections.summary: Ministry says it will not review the maximum penalty now but is reviewing guidelines on warnings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower whether the Ministry will consider increasing the maximum fine for employers who illegally deploy a foreign domestic worker.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: They could also be debarred from hiring foreign domestic workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: While the current administrative financial penalty is capped at $10,000, the eventual penalty takes into consideration the severity of the infringement and number of counts of the infringement that is committed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Between 2017 and 2019, 16 employers were issued with financial penalties each year, ranging from $3,300 to $24,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The number of cases of illegal deployment of foreign domestic workers has remained relatively stable over the past few years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We do not plan to review the maximum penalty at the moment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: However, we are reviewing the guidelines to see if the cases currently resolved with a warning, should in future be subject to a financial penalty.

sections.label: Review consultation with parties
sections.summary: The review is on-going and the Ministry is consulting various parties, welcoming input from Mr Louis Ng.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The review is on-going and we are also in the process of consulting various parties and if Mr Louis Ng has strong views or is in touch with organisations that have views on this, we welcome their input as well.
